info.title: Metadata API
info.description: Application and maintainer metadata with idempotent association management. Send the configured API key as Authorization: Bearer <key>. Health probes (/health/live and /health/ready) are anonymous, return plain text, and are excluded from this reference. Unsupported HTTP methods return 405 ProblemDetails with an Allow header. Requests exceeding the configured body limit (default 65536 bytes) return 413, even on operations without a request body. 429 responses include Retry-After; exhausted database lock waits return 503.

post.description: Creates metadata with a server-generated ID and no maintainer associations.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next rate-limit window.

get.description: Returns applications ordered by ID ascending. Limit defaults to 20 (1–100); offset defaults to 0 (0–10000). Invalid values return 400. NextOffset is null at the end or traversal cap; concurrent writes may shift pages.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size (default 20).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of resources to skip (default 0).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next rate-limit window.

CreateApplicationRequest.description: Title is required. Optional fields may be omitted or null; PUT clears omitted fields. Strings are trimmed; blank optional strings become null. Maximum normalized lengths: title/company 200, version/license 100, website/source 2048, description 4000. Version must be SemVer 2.0.0; website/source must be absolute HTTP(S) URLs without credentials. Only description permits tab/newline control characters.

CreateMaintainerRequest.description: Name and email are required, trimmed, non-blank strings with no control characters. Maximum normalized lengths: name 200, email 254. Email must be valid without a display name.

UpdateApplicationRequest.description: Title is required. Optional fields may be omitted or null; PUT clears omitted fields. Strings are trimmed; blank optional strings become null. Maximum normalized lengths: title/company 200, version/license 100, website/source 2048, description 4000. Version must be SemVer 2.0.0; website/source must be absolute HTTP(S) URLs without credentials. Only description permits tab/newline control characters.

UpdateMaintainerRequest.description: Name and email are required, trimmed, non-blank strings with no control characters. Maximum normalized lengths: name 200, email 254. Email must be valid without a display name.
